cases.description: Ordinary documentation is not a coding agent configuration
A hand-written Anthropic tool-use loop that executes tool input and feeds results back
An OpenAI chat completion tool loop that dispatches the selected tool and feeds its result back

files.agent.py:
import json
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
tools = [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "lookup", "parameters": {"type": "object"}}}]
messages = [{"role": "user", "content": "find the order"}]
while True:
    r = client.chat.completions.create(model="m", messages=messages, tools=tools)
    msg = r.choices[0].message
    if not msg.tool_calls:
        break
    messages.append(msg)
    for call in msg.tool_calls:
        result = lookup(**json.loads(call.function.arguments))
        messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call.id, "content": json.dumps(result)})

cases.description: An ordinary queue consumer is not an autonomous AI agent
A bare tool decorator is neither LangChain attribution nor agent execution
An OpenAI Responses model call and active named tool dispatch identify an agent
A model call with named tools, a function-call response and assigned handler result identifies an agent

files.worker.py:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
response = client.responses.create(model='gpt-4o', tools=TOOLS, input='query')
calls = [item for item in response.output if item.type == 'function_call']
for item in calls:
    answer = lookup(item.arguments)
    conversation.append({'type': 'function_call_output', 'call_id': item.call_id, 'output': answer})
